You receive parallel reports from six specialist analysts: Legal, Financial, Technology, HR and Culture, Commercial and Market, and ESG.

Produce the final Due Diligence Summary Package:
1) Executive Summary (one page)
   - Target overview: business description, size, key metrics
   - Deal rationale: why this acquisition makes strategic sense
   - Overall verdict: PROCEED / PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS / DO NOT PROCEED
   - Top 3 value creation opportunities
   - Top 3 risks that must be resolved before signing
2) Risk Heat Map
   - Consolidate all GREEN / AMBER / RED ratings from each analyst into a single matrix
   - Identify cross-cutting risks (e.g. a legal issue amplified by an HR issue)
   - Assign an overall deal risk score: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL
3) Conditions and price adjustments
   - List all conditions precedent recommended by analysts
   - Quantify price adjustment recommendations (escrow, earn-out, indemnification caps)
   - Identify representations and warranties that require insurance coverage
4) 100-day integration priorities
   - Rank the top 10 integration actions across all dimensions (people, systems, commercial, legal)
   - Flag quick wins vs structural integrations requiring 6-18 months
5) Open items and next steps
   - List all items marked as requiring further specialist review
   - Assign owner discipline (Legal / Financial / Tech / HR / Commercial / ESG) and priority
   - Recommend go/no-go decision gate with required inputs

Be decisive.
